$comment: Fictional learning data for Northwind Trading (see agents.json, knowledge.json). Memory records are what agents learned from chats with the signed-in user (scope User, status Active); policies control capture (learning agent, approval), retrieval and promotion to knowledge. Times relative to the fixed capture clock 2026-01-01T09:00:00Z.

memories.name: MEM-0412
memories.title: Prefers weekly summaries on Monday
memories.summary_text: Maya wants the open-ticket summary every Monday at 8 am, grouped by region, with refunds over $500 called out first.

memories.name: MEM-0409
memories.title: Handles the EMEA returns queue
memories.summary_text: Maya owns escalations for the EMEA returns queue and approves refunds up to $2,000 without a second sign-off.

memories.name: MEM-0403
memories.title: Bluewater is the default carrier
memories.summary_text: Decided on 18 Dec: ship all EU replacement orders with Bluewater Logistics unless the customer pays for express.

memories.name: MEM-0398
memories.title: Replies in a friendly, short tone
memories.summary_text: Drafted customer replies should be under 80 words, start with the customer's first name and avoid the word "unfortunately".

memories.name: MEM-0391
memories.title: Holiday stock is tight on trail boots
memories.summary_text: Trail boot exchanges spiked 3x after 20 Dec; suggest store credit first when sizes 41-43 are out of stock.

memories.name: MEM-0385
memories.title: Works from Lisbon, UTC+0
memories.summary_text: Maya is based in Lisbon and is online 8 am to 5 pm local time; schedule follow-ups inside those hours.

memories.name: MEM-0377
memories.title: Invoices over $10k need a PO match
memories.summary_text: Every supplier invoice above $10,000 that Maya reviewed was held until a matching purchase order was attached.

memories.name: MEM-0369
memories.title: Q4 return reasons summary
memories.summary_text: Top Q4 return reasons from Maya's chats: wrong size (41%), arrived late (22%), changed mind (18%), damaged in transit (9%).
